note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

parser.reason: TypeScript: ts/src/translate.ts imports '@tabnas/parser' to build each grammar's parser (new Tabnas().use(...)) and to subscribe to ZON's lexer, and ts/package.json declares it as a peer. The command also compiles programs with @tabnas/alchemy's language, which imports the engine (alchemy ts/src/grammar.ts); since 2026-10-06 alchemy declares the engine as an OPTIONAL peer so that packages taking only @tabnas/alchemy/shared do not install it, and npm does not install an optional peer, so the host that loads the language declares it. Go: go/translate imports the engine to subscribe to ZON's lexer; to build the parsers of the two grammars whose Go packages offer no constructor, feed's (a new engine given feed's defaults, as feed's documentation shows) and proto's (an engine with the 8,192-token rewind history proto's own Parse gives it); to read the typed values three modules build (proto's descriptor, feed's AtomFeed, chess's Database) back from their JSON encoding as the engine's ordered map, so that their members keep an order; and to read an engine error (TabnasError) as transduce's parser source reports one, for the documents read as such a module's tree. ZON's Go reader builds an integer no float64 holds exactly as a *big.Int, which no transduce event carries, so the host replaces the token's value with the {"$big": "<digits>"} object ZON's translation part declares (the TypeScript port does the same for a bigint). Rust names no engine type: each grammar crate's make() hands translate its parser, and tabnas-zon's Rust reader builds the $big object itself, so the crate declares nothing, and tabnas-alchemy brings the engine to it transitively.
parser.repair: TypeScript: none is owed. The difference is npm's packaging, not the code; the maintainer ruled it intentional on 2026-10-06 (alchemy's engine peer is optional, so the host that runs the language declares it), and translate imports the engine besides. Go: the import goes away only when every use does: when tabnas-zon's Go reader builds the declared {"$big": "<digits>"} object itself, as its Rust reader does, so that no host adapts it (whether it should is zon's: its readers' forms differ by runtime: bigint, *big.Int, the object); when tabnas-feed and tabnas-proto offer a constructor, as chess, css, expr and semver do (Make, MakeJsonic); when the modules that build typed values give the tree their parts declare; and when transduce reads a module's tree as it reads a parser's value, its engine errors included. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
